title: Apple Intelligence Foundation Language Models Tech Report 2025

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using targeted safety evaluation datasets through internal and external human evaluation, auto-grading, and benchmarking against external models on tasks such as summarization, question-answering, and brainstorming.

Assessed using customized datasets across different languages and locales, refined by native speakers, and evaluated through human red teaming to identify and mitigate culture-specific risks and stereotypes.
